_comment: Additional permissions continuityops-gha needs to manage terraform/envs/account. Attach as an inline or managed policy on the role. Required because the role is NOT Terraform-managed (created out-of-band at bootstrap), so Terraform cannot grant these to itself. Verified missing on run 31267523721: AccessDeniedException on budgets:ModifyBudget and ce:CreateAnomalyMonitor.
_scope_note: Read-only cost inspection (ce:GetCostAndUsage etc.) is deliberately NOT here — that belongs to continuityops-agent-ro. This addon grants only what is needed to CREATE and maintain the guardrails themselves.
